design.coverage: all eleven HTTP questions, including multi-row, 1MiB and Unicode paths
design.loadDesign: a small predeclared load ladder selected after driver-headroom calibration
design.repeats: at least four balanced independent pairs; reuse validated calibration policy
design.primary: P50 and P95 comparison; P99 only with its separately satisfied sample requirement
design.samplePolicy: P99 requires at least 1000 correct observations per question/load/arm; no pooled samples or lowered gate
design.calibration: reuse real A/A, known regression, headroom, steady-state and observer-cost evidence after acceptance

limitations: The 15–30 minute range is a design range; no executable standard preset is published.
Question/load/duration and all statistical budgets must be fixed and validated before implementation is marked ready.
Use quick for the implemented local planning path. Standard/full must not silently fall back to quick.
